_note: DANH MUC DUNG CHUNG cho luong Video Remotion. GPT (sidecar/remotion_plan.py) chi duoc chon id trong file nay; bo dung Remotion (remotion-src/*.tsx) ve dung cac id nay. Them muc moi thi phai them CA hai phia: mo ta o day + cach ve trong remotion-src/. Khong co emoji_pop: icon emoji tho bi cam tu 2026-09-27.

transitions.label: Cắt thẳng
transitions.look: khong co hieu ung, doi canh ngay lap tuc
transitions.use_when: mac dinh cho jump-cut trong cung mot mach noi

transitions.label: Hoà tan
transitions.look: canh cu mo dan, canh moi hien dan chong len nhau
transitions.use_when: chuyen y nhe nhang, ke chuyen cam xuc, doi boi canh cham
transitions.avoid_when: video nhip nhanh, hai hoac hype

transitions.label: Tối rồi sáng
transitions.look: canh cu toi han ve den roi canh moi sang len
transitions.use_when: ket thuc mot chuong, chuyen sang phan hoan toan khac, truoc CTA trang trong
transitions.avoid_when: giua mot cau chuyen dang lien mach

transitions.label: Loé trắng
transitions.look: loe sang trang mot nhip ngay diem cat
transitions.use_when: hook -> than video, tiet lo bat ngo, twist, chuyen sang con so gay soc

transitions.label: Zoom xuyên
transitions.look: canh cu phong to lao vao kem nhoe, canh moi bung ra tu gan
transitions.use_when: tang toc, vao phan quan trong, nhan manh buoc tiep theo

transitions.label: Zoom lùi
transitions.look: canh cu thu nho lui ra xa, canh moi tu gan ve binh thuong
transitions.use_when: tong ket, nhin lai toan canh, chuyen tu chi tiet ra tong the

transitions.label: Lia ngang trái
transitions.look: hai canh bi keo vut sang trai kem nhoe chuyen dong
transitions.use_when: liet ke y tiep theo, doi goc nhanh, nhip trend

transitions.label: Lia ngang phải
transitions.look: hai canh bi keo vut sang phai kem nhoe chuyen dong
transitions.use_when: quay lai y truoc, doi ben, nhip trend

transitions.label: Đẩy lên
transitions.look: canh moi day canh cu troi len tren (nhu luot TikTok)
transitions.use_when: sang muc tiep theo trong danh sach, 'tiep theo la...'
transitions.avoid_when: giua mot cau dang noi do

transitions.label: Đẩy ngang
transitions.look: canh moi day canh cu sang trai
transitions.use_when: so sanh truoc/sau, chuyen buoc trong huong dan

transitions.label: Gạt màn
transitions.look: mot duong gat cheo quet qua de lo canh moi
transitions.use_when: truoc/sau, doi boi canh ro rang

transitions.label: Mở vòng tròn
transitions.look: canh moi no ra tu vong tron giua khung
transitions.use_when: tiet lo ket qua, 'va day la...', mo dau phan moi vui ve

transitions.label: Nhiễu glitch
transitions.look: tach mau RGB, rung giat ky thuat so ngay diem cat
transitions.use_when: cong nghe, bat ngo, phu dinh ('sai!'), meme vibe

transitions.label: Xoay
transitions.look: canh cu xoay kem phong to roi canh moi xoay ve
transitions.use_when: doi mood dot ngot, hai huoc, 'nhung khoan da'
transitions.avoid_when: tone nghiem tuc, dung nhieu lan

transitions.label: Mờ chuyển
transitions.look: canh cu nhoe dan, canh moi tu nhoe ro dan
transitions.use_when: hoi tuong, chuyen thoi gian, mo mong

effects.label: Punch zoom
effects.look: phong to giat nhanh roi giu, nhu camera dap vao
effects.use_when: dung cau chot, tu khoa, con so, cu dam

effects.label: Đẩy máy chậm
effects.look: phong to rat cham suot doan (push-in)
effects.use_when: doan noi dai 3s+ can giu nhip, ke chuyen, cam xuc lang

effects.label: Lùi máy lộ cảnh
effects.look: bat dau gan roi lui ve khung binh thuong
effects.use_when: tiet lo toan canh, ket qua sau khi giau

effects.label: Rung máy
effects.look: khung hinh rung lac manh ngan
effects.use_when: soc, gian, bung no, meme hai, nhan phu dinh
effects.avoid_when: tone nhe nhang, dung qua 2 lan

effects.label: Loé sáng
effects.look: man hinh loe trang mot nhip roi tat
effects.use_when: khoanh khac 'a ha', tiet lo, beat drop

effects.label: Tách màu RGB
effects.look: vien do/xanh lech nhau nhu glitch
effects.use_when: cong nghe, bat ngo, nhan manh gay gat

effects.label: Đen trắng
effects.look: khung hinh mat mau thanh den trang
effects.use_when: hoi tuong, noi dau, 'truoc kia', drama
effects.avoid_when: doan vui, doan khoe san pham mau sac

effects.label: Tối viền
effects.look: bon goc toi lai don mat vao giua
effects.use_when: tam su, bi mat, tap trung vao nguoi noi

effects.label: Lấy nét
effects.look: bat dau nhoe roi net dan
effects.use_when: mo dau doan moi, 'tinh day di', tu mo mong ve thuc te

effects.label: Vệt sáng ấm
effects.look: vet sang cam/vang troi qua khung
effects.use_when: cam xuc am ap, ky niem, san pham sang trong
effects.avoid_when: tone nghiem tuc, cong nghe lanh

effects.label: Viền điện ảnh
effects.look: hai dai den tren duoi nhu phim
effects.use_when: khoanh khac tram, ke chuyen dien anh, truoc cu twist
effects.avoid_when: khi co caption o sat tren/duoi

effects.label: Nhịp tim
effects.look: khung hinh phap phong theo nhip
effects.use_when: hoi hop, dem nguoc, cang thang truoc tiet lo

effects.label: Hạt phim
effects.look: hat nhieu nhe nhu phim cu
effects.use_when: hoai niem, vintage, ke chuyen xua

effects.label: Mắt cá (fisheye)
effects.look: ong kinh mat ca: giua phinh to, vien cong + vien den tron, nhu camera hanh dong ap sat
effects.use_when: hook 0.5-2s dau, khoanh khac soc / hai / nang luong cao
effects.avoid_when: doan tram, cam xuc lang, doan dai

effects.label: Tập trung (radial blur)
effects.look: nhoe + toi dan ra 4 goc, giu net vung giua mat — keo mat nguoi xem vao chu the
effects.use_when: hook, cau chot quan trong, khi chu nhan hien giua khung

effects.label: Lia trái
effects.look: khung truot cham sang trai (pan) co phong nhe
effects.use_when: canh noi dai, B-roll tinh, ke chuyen

effects.label: Lia phải
effects.look: khung truot cham sang phai (pan) co phong nhe
effects.use_when: canh noi dai, B-roll tinh, ke chuyen

grades.label: Giữ màu gốc
grades.use_when: video da dep san, hoac muon tu nhien nhat

grades.label: Ấm
grades.look: am, hoi cam vang, da nguoi dep
grades.use_when: vlog, ke chuyen, lam dep, do an

grades.label: Lạnh
grades.use_when: cong nghe, chuyen nghiep, mua he mat

grades.label: Rực rỡ
grades.look: tang bao hoa + tuong phan, mau no
grades.use_when: hype, trend, san pham nhieu mau

grades.label: Điện ảnh
grades.look: tuong phan cao, bong xanh ngoc - da cam
grades.use_when: ke chuyen drama, quang cao cao cap

grades.label: Hoài cổ
grades.look: bac mau, am vang, hoi nhat
grades.use_when: hoai niem, ky niem, ke chuyen xua

grades.label: Trầm
grades.look: toi, it bao hoa, tuong phan manh
grades.use_when: tam su, chu de nang ne, bi an

grades.label: Sáng trong
grades.use_when: lam dep, huong dan, tuoi tan

grades.label: Đen trắng
grades.use_when: phong cach nghe thuat, chu de nghiem tuc

caption_styles.label: Hộp TikTok
caption_styles.look: chu tren nen hop bo tron dac (trang nen den chu hoac nguoc lai)
caption_styles.use_when: de doc tren moi nen, kieu TikTok native

caption_styles.label: Viền đậm
caption_styles.look: chu trang day, vien den day, bong do
caption_styles.use_when: caption loi noi tieu chuan, de doc

caption_styles.label: Karaoke từng chữ
caption_styles.look: ca cau hien, chu DANG NOI doi mau nhan va nay nhe
caption_styles.use_when: phu de loi noi lien tuc, video talking-head nhip nhanh

caption_styles.label: Bật từng chữ
caption_styles.look: tung chu bat ra lan luot theo giong noi
caption_styles.use_when: cau ngan dat, nhip nhanh, trend

caption_styles.label: Tiêu đề lớn
caption_styles.look: chu RAT to, dam, mau nhan, nay vao
caption_styles.use_when: hook, con so, tu khoa chot, 1-4 tu

caption_styles.label: Neon
caption_styles.use_when: dem, cong nghe, party, nhan manh vui

caption_styles.label: Đánh máy
caption_styles.look: chu hien dan tung ky tu
caption_styles.use_when: bi an, tiet lo tung chut, trich dan

caption_styles.label: Bút dạ quang
caption_styles.look: chu den tren vet but da quang mau nhan chay qua
caption_styles.use_when: nhan tu khoa trong cau giai thich, huong dan

caption_styles.label: Chú thích dưới
caption_styles.look: thanh chu nho goc duoi kem vach mau
caption_styles.use_when: ten, chuc danh, nguon, ten san pham

caption_styles.label: Tối giản
caption_styles.look: chu trang vua, bong mo, mo vao nhe
caption_styles.use_when: chu phu, tone sang trong, nhe nhang
